svg.title: How to recover deleted files in Windows: distinguishing the Recycle Bin, cloud storage, and Windows File Recovery
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to recover deleted files in Windows: distinguishing
the Recycle Bin, cloud storage, and Windows File
Recovery
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-05
First, look in the Windows Recycle Bin
If the file is in the Windows Recycle Bin,
recovery is simple.
Check the cloud Recycle Bin and
backups
Files deleted from OneDrive or SharePoint may
not appear in the PC’s Recycle Bin.
Reduce use of the drive before
recovery
Microsoft’s Windows File Recovery documentation
explains that reducing or avoiding computer use
can increase the chance of recovering a file.
Check the Windows File Recovery
command format
If you cannot find the file in the Recycle Bin
or a backup, you can use the Windows File
Recovery (winfr) command-line app installed from…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
